subject: Portal onboarding — signer delegation mapping & MSA redline impact
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: ClearWave Procurement <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-25 09:22 -07:00
Subject: Portal onboarding — signer delegation mapping & MSA redline impact

Hi Aisha / ClearWave team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We ran a quick preflight on the docs you shared and surfaced two items that will impact the portal activation timeline unless resolved this week:

1) Signer/delegation matrix — the order form expects a single "Billing Signatory" field at the PO level; ClearWave's procurement policy requires dual sign-off for >$250k (Billing + Legal). That will require either:
  - a signer-delegation field mapping in Ariba that allows two attributes, or
  - a documented signer escalation rule so a second signer request is automatically routed.

2) MSA redline: your counsel added a data-retention clause (Section 7.3) that conflicts with our standard telemetry retention for portal logs. Legal (cc'ed) recommended a short carveout limited to PO/audit artifacts.

Attached: ClearWave_OrderForm_v2.pdf and a suggested redline (Redline_MSA_June2027.docx). I've also exported a quick sig_matrix.csv showing which buyers at ClearWave are authorized by group — this will help the mapping.

Proposed next steps:
- Kimberly: can you confirm whether Redwood can accept a dual-signer flow in Ariba (yes/no) by EOD tomorrow?
- Aisha: please confirm whether your team can supply a delegated-signature attribute in the enrollment payload or if you need Redwood to host a signer routing rule.
- If neither option is viable, we should schedule a 30-min working session to walk the portal team through an interim manual routing plan.

Thanks — aiming to keep the activation window in the 2-week target.

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132
From: Aisha Banerjee <aisha.b@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwavehealth.com, legal@clearwavehealth.com
Date: 2027-07-25 11:09 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — signer delegation mapping & MSA redline impact

Jonas,

Appreciate the summary. Quick answers:
- We can provide a delegated-signature attribute in the enrollment payload, but it takes our integration team ~5 business days to expose that field in the enrollment API.
- The dual-signature requirement is policy-driven; we can't change it, but we can temporarily accept a documented delegation rule while the API change is in progress.

On the MSA redline: legal flagged Section 7.3. Our counsel prefers explicit retention windows (7 years for procurement records). If Redwood requires a shorter telemetry retention, can you propose exact language for the carveout? Our Legal (cc'd) will review.

We can do a working session Friday afternoon (UTC-7) if that works.

Thanks,
Aisha

--
Aisha Banerjee
Dir., Supplier Operations | ClearWave Health
aisha.b@clearwavehealth.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: ClearWave Procurement <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-26 08:34 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — signer delegation mapping & MSA redline impact

Jonas — thanks for pulling this together. A few notes from Legal + Ops:

1) Ariba/Coupa mapping: Redwood Dedicated Ops supports an extended attribute for "secondary_signer_email" or "approver_group_id". We can implement the mapping on our side and map it to the PO metadata so the PO shows both signers. That would avoid waiting for ClearWave's integration work, but it requires ClearWave to include the secondary signer value in the enrollment manifest or allow us to fetch it from your SFTP sync.

2) MSA retention clause: attached is a short paragraph we can insert as a carveout. Suggestion:
  "Notwithstanding Section 7.3, Redwood will retain portal telemetry for operational diagnostics for up to 18 months. Procurement artifacts (executed orders, invoices, and PO acknowledgements) related to ClearWave purchase orders will be retained for seven (7) years solely for audit purposes. Redwood will not use procurement telemetry for model training or product development without explicit consent."

If ClearWave Legal accepts that language, we can include it as an MSA addendum and proceed with portal activation.

3) Action items:
  - Marissa: I'll need the mapping spec for how you want the PO to display the second signer on the UI (email vs. name+title).
  - Jonas: confirm Friday 14:00 PT for the working session with ClearWave integration and legal teams; I'll invite Ops engineers.

Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: ClearWave Procurement <procurement@clearwavehealth.com>, Aisha Banerjee <aisha.b@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-28 15:11 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding — signer delegation mapping & MSA redline impact

Thanks everyone — quick recap and decisions from today's call:

- Decision: Redwood will implement a server-side mapping to accept "secondary_signer_email" from the enrollment manifest and populate PO metadata. ClearWave will provide the sig_matrix.csv via SFTP by EOD Tuesday. (Attachment: sig_matrix.csv placeholder).
- MSA: Kimberly's carveout language was accepted by ClearWave Legal with one minor edit (added phrase: "for the purposes of regulatory audits"). Legal will exchange an executed addendum via DocuSign by next week.
- Temporary flow: while integration is in progress, ClearWave will approve the first batch of POs via email escrow to procurement@clearwavehealth.com and cc redwood-ops@redwood.com.

Next steps and owners:
- ClearWave (Aisha): upload sig_matrix.csv to our SFTP and confirm when complete.
- Kimberly: prepare the MSA addendum in DocuSign and send to Aisha for countersignature.
- Marissa: ops to schedule integration window (2 business days) to configure the PO metadata mapping in Ariba/Coupa.

I'll follow up with a concise activation checklist and include the DocuSign link once ready.

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
